items.title: ResolutionRecord V1 contract and pure normalization
scope: canonical JSON Schema and TypeScript type
pure condition and logical path normalization
acceptance: schema rejects unknown and machine-specific fields
conditions follow the mode protocol order
logical paths contain no absolute, parent, backslash, drive or pnpm store paths
input ordering does not change canonical output
existing ProductGraph V1 output is unchanged
nonGoals: Vite, TypeScript, Node or Vitest adapters
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), Node v24.20.0 and pnpm 10.32.1: build, typecheck, 74 Vitest tests, 8 S1 tests and verify:docs passed; result recorded in .codex/tasks/a1-s2-01-resolution-record-2026-09-06.md

items.title: Package exports and relative source resolver
scope: package exports and relative ESM resolution
declared dependency and package escape checks
acceptance: public exports resolve uniquely
private, undeclared and escaping imports fail before code execution
records are independent of checkout and pnpm store paths
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), Node v24.20.0 and pnpm 10.32.1: build, typecheck, 92 Vitest tests, 8 S1 tests and verify:docs passed; result recorded in .codex/tasks/a1-s2-02-source-resolver-2026-09-06.md

items.title: Target boundary and dynamic import policy
scope: static and opaque dynamic import classification
acceptance: server secrets and built-ins cannot enter web/shared
opaque cross-owner dynamic imports fail
diagnostics match S2 codes
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), Node v24.20.0 and pnpm 10.32.1: build, typecheck, 109 Vitest tests, 8 S1 tests and verify:docs passed; result recorded in .codex/tasks/a1-s2-03-target-import-policy-2026-09-06.md

items.title: Tool adapters and cross-platform S2 evidence
scope: TypeScript, Node, Vite and Vitest trace adapters
acceptance: five resolution modes reconcile
Linux, macOS and Windows transcripts match
S2 pass criteria are completely evidenced
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), arm64, Node v24.20.0 and pnpm 10.32.1: TypeScript 5.9.3, Vite 8.2.2, Node and Vitest 4.1.11 reconciled five modes across two checkouts and two isolated pnpm stores; 109 Vitest, 8 S1 and 4 S2 tests plus build, typecheck and verify:docs passed. Canonical transcript is spikes/s2-resolver/transcripts/macos-arm64.json.

GitHub Actions run 34016987463 for commit aab99489b492fb78bd0bc14b6f5fae69921fc9d0 passed the same two-checkout, two-store S2 corpus on ubuntu-24.04, macos-15 and windows-2025; all platforms matched records hash 71652e6c253cd52cfcd0dde6a97314ab1e389548396f6269d81fcb51bda0a969. Detailed evidence is recorded in .codex/tasks/a1-s2-04-tool-adapters-2026-09-06.md.

items.title: Freeze bundle trace contract and fixture matrix
scope: Vite/Rollup observation runner and fixture matrix
deterministic source edge to bundle module reconciliation
acceptance: trace excludes absolute and store paths and is deterministic across checkouts
legal and illegal fixture edges reconcile before artifact publication
tool versions, runner environments and failure choices are frozen
nonGoals: new runtime dependencies without supply-chain review
evidence: 2026-09-06 on macOS 27.0 (26A5425a), arm64, Node v24.20.0, pnpm 10.32.1 and Vite 8.2.2: canonical JS module trace reconciled static and literal dynamic imports across two checkouts and two isolated pnpm stores; undeclared dependency, server SecretRef, cross-target import, private export and package escape failed before bundling; missing/extra bundle modules fail with stable reconciliation diagnostics. 109 Vitest, 8 S1, 4 S2 and 5 S3 tests plus build, typecheck and verify:docs passed. Canonical transcript is spikes/s3-bundle-trace/transcripts/macos-arm64.json with trace hash fc720952e1c552f46d3894077baf1f203fe3c8bc09596cc8f785bbccf3068e2e.

items.title: Expand bundle trace artifact coverage and cross-platform evidence
scope: artifact classification and forbidden artifact detection
outputs: expanded S3 trace schema and runner
acceptance: all RFC-0013 S3 artifact classes are observable without absolute or store paths
unenabled or forbidden target artifacts fail publication reconciliation
the common corpus produces the same canonical trace identity on Linux, macOS and Windows or records an explicit approved platform distinction
S2 resolver records remain unchanged
nonGoals: new runtime dependencies without supply-chain review
